questions: Does 'repeated value' mean exactly two occurrences of the same value, or could it be more than two (e.g., three identical numbers)?
If multiple shortest subarrays exist with the same minimal length, should we output that length (as the problem seems to imply), or is any ambiguity about handling ties relevant?
Is the subarray required to be contiguous (as typical for subarrays), or could it be non-contiguous (like a subsequence)?
Should the output be 0 or a specific sentinel if no such subarray exists (i.e., all elements are distinct)?
Are we allowed to use O(N^2) algorithms, or is an efficient O(N) or O(N log N) solution expected given constraints?
Does 'shortest such subarray' mean the subarray with the minimum number of elements between the first and last occurrence of the repeated value, inclusive?
If a value appears more than twice, should we consider only the closest pair, or all pairs?
Is the input guaranteed to have at least one repeated value, or should the code handle the case with all distinct elements?
